description: Fetch one docs page as markdown by the id `search` returned (a path such as /platforms/python), or by its full docs.bithuman.ai URL. Returns JSON {id, title, text (the whole page as markdown), url, metadata}. Example: {"id": "/api/agents"}. Errors: an unknown path (run `search` for the id) and a URL outside docs.bithuman.ai are refused. Read-only, no sign-in.
name: fetch
title: Fetch a bitHuman docs page
